candidates.title: City station readings (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of hourly NO2 and PM2.5 by station, with UTC hour start timestamps. Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01 (end null), so it covers the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 but not the prototype window. Access is by request to the Environment Monitoring Unit; refreshed hourly per catalog.
suspected_issues: Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30 and has no readings after that date, but the catalog still lists the network as active (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01).
Station location/coordinates not documented in the catalog entry; needed to measure distance to traffic counters and weather point.
Catalog has no unit check beyond column description (ug/m3 stated); no missing-hour rule documented.
No data before 2023-01-01, so it cannot serve the prototype window.

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Only traffic source found for N2. Hourly counts per road counter near monitoring stations; catalog coverage from 2021-01-01, so it spans the production window. Owner Mobility Office; access by request.
suspected_issues: Road counters replaced on 2024-03-18; counts were per direction before and combined in both directions after (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02). Catalog has no note; comparing across the change without adjustment is flagged as invalid by the wiki.
Timestamps are local time (ts_local), not UTC; DST handling needed before joining to UTC air and weather data.
Counter-to-air-station mapping and counter coordinates are not documented in the catalog entry.
Vehicle class and counting method not stated in catalog.

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregated daily respiratory visit counts by district, which is the form the clinic data policy permits for this analysis. Catalog coverage starts 2022-01-01, so it covers the production window. Owner Clinical Analytics; contains no patient identifiers per catalog.
suspected_issues: Respiratory definition (ICD codes or diagnosis groups) not documented in catalog.
No small-cell suppression rule documented; district-day counts may be small enough to re-identify.
Clinic-closure and holiday days may show zeros that look like low demand.
Lawful basis / consent for sharing aggregate counts not recorded in the catalog or wiki (clinic_data_policy only permits daily counts by district).
District code system and join to a usable geography not documented.
Coding or system migration mid-window not documented.

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Only registered source for hourly temperature and humidity covering both windows. Approved for prototyping and production in the register (agreement not required, open data). Must request temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m explicitly, with timezone UTC.
suspected_issues: Register default_query coordinates are Milan (45.4642, 9.1900), not the brief's Lisbon. The Valdena location is not yet chosen in the inputs; it must be recorded in decisions.md before the call.
Default hourly list is temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation only; relative humidity must be added.
Output is modelled reanalysis, not station-observed; grid resolution smooths urban effects. Label accordingly.
Licence terms are at terms_url; attribution required per terms (not read by scout).

searches_run: hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5
respiratory clinic visits daily counts district
unmet_needs: N1 prototype (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04): no internal source; internal station data starts 2023-01-01, and the catalog search for a legacy 2004-2005 dataset returned nothing. A public hourly Italian air-quality dataset must be supplied as a link (link.*) by the human. Its licence must be read at source; prototype use only under policy.open_data_links.
N2 prototype: not required by the spec (production only), so no gap.

N6 (national PM2.5 deaths, annual, both windows): no internal catalog match and no register source. ISTAT, ISPRA or EEA data must be supplied as a link. Estimate type (observed vs modelled burden) must be stated.

N2 production: the only candidate is internal traffic.hourly_counts, which has the 2024-03-18 counter change and local timestamps. No external traffic source is registered, so there is no fallback if counter history is unusable.
N1 production: the only candidate is internal airq.station_readings. VR-03 stopped on 2024-06-30, and no delivery date for the requested station data is on file. No fallback in the register.
N4 production: the internal aggregate exists, but the lawful basis for sharing, suppression rule and respiratory definition are undocumented. No external fallback is registered.
N5: out of scope. Not searched or profiled beyond the catalog listing, which shows one row per patient visit.
